newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 16.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Twenty six parliamentarians leave for Manila to attend seminar on ethnic conflict and struggles for self-determination organised by International Alert. This is the highest number of parliamentarians to attend conference abroad.
Pirates abduct captain of Thai fishing vessel outside Colombo port.
Heads of 238 local government councils, elected in last month's poll, take oaths.
Opposition United National Party challenges legality of proposed Broadcasting Authority Bill.
Government committee studying restructuing of local government system recommends Citizens' Charter giving people more power and raising standards of government services.

Exchgange controller demands explanations from heads of state banks, mercantile firms and senior partner of law firm over alleged violation of Exchange Control regulations in sale of Kotagala Plantations after its privatisation.
